KB.Article.Stations.Title: Listening, Managing Favorites & Discovering Stations
KB.Article.Stations.Summary: Start right away with KINK, search thousands of stations by audio quality, and organize your favorites.
KB.Article.Stations.Body:
Dial comes ready with four preconfigured KINK channels (KINK, KINK Distortion, KINK 80's, and KINK 90's). Just click any station to start listening.

• Discover new stations: Open the Discover tab at the top to search tens of thousands of worldwide stations by name, music style (like Rock or 80s), or country. Use the quality filter to show only streams with at least 128 or 192 kbps—keeping lower-quality streams out of your results. Your preference is saved automatically, and clicking Listen lets you preview any station before adding it to your favorites.
• Edit your favorites: Click the pencil icon next to Favorites to organize your list. You can add your own station link, rename stations, select multiple stations (with checkboxes or Shift+click), and drag them into your favorite order.
• Backup & sharing: Use Export and Import to save your favorites to a file, share them with a code, or import an existing Radi-oh! backup.
• Layout: In Settings → Radio, choose whether you prefer a compact list or station cards, with or without numbers and in your preferred text size.
KB.Article.StreamBuffer.Title: Smooth Playback, Track Info & Spotify/YouTube Music
KB.Article.StreamBuffer.Summary: Buffer ahead to prevent dropouts, see what song is playing, and look it up in your music app.
KB.Article.StreamBuffer.Body:
Nothing ruins radio like crackles or dropouts. That's why Dial always loads a few seconds of audio ahead so brief hiccups on your internet connection go unnoticed.

• Choose your buffer: In Settings → Radio, pick how many seconds Dial buffers ahead (5 seconds by default; 2 seconds starts fastest, while 10–30 seconds gives extra stability on spotty Wi-Fi).
• What song is playing?: When a station sends song title and artist info, Dial shows it live in the player, in the mini-player, and right in the top titlebar next to the version badge. The red ON AIR badge indicates when a station is playing live.
• Look up tracks in your music service: Hearing a great song? Click the button next to the song title to look it up immediately in Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer, or Tidal so you can add it to your playlist. In Settings → Radio, pick your preferred music service or turn the button off.
KB.Article.TimerMini.Title: Mini-Player, Sleep Timer & Listening Stats
KB.Article.TimerMini.Summary: A compact desktop player, automatic stop timer for bedtime, and stats on what you listen to most.
KB.Article.TimerMini.Body:
• Mini-player: Want a tiny player in the corner of your screen while you work or browse? Click the mini-player icon in the player bar or press Ctrl+M. Use the pin icon to keep it on top of other windows, complete with a volume slider, animated audio level bars, and a quick track-lookup button.
• Sleep timer: Like falling asleep to the radio? Click the clock icon in the player bar and pick how long Dial should keep playing (from 15 minutes up to 6 hours, or enter any number of minutes). Dial stops automatically, and you can cancel the timer anytime from the screen or the tray icon.
• Listening stats: Curious which station you listen to most? Click the chart icon to see your total listening time per station.
KB.Article.Hotkeys.Title: Shortcuts & Keyboard Media Keys
KB.Article.Hotkeys.Summary: Control Dial with your keyboard's media keys or set up your own shortcuts that work from any app.
KB.Article.Hotkeys.Body:
• Media keys: The Play, Pause, Next, and Previous keys on your keyboard (as well as the Windows volume overlay) always work out of the box.
• Shortcuts inside Dial: Press Ctrl+1 (Radio), Ctrl+2 (Discover), or Ctrl+9 (Settings) to switch tabs quickly, press F1 anytime to open this guide and the list of new features, or press Ctrl+M to switch to the mini-player.
• Custom global shortcuts: Turn on 'Global hotkeys' in Settings → Radio to control Dial even while using other apps. You can customize all five actions (Play/Stop, Next station, Previous station, Mute, and Show/Hide window)—just click the record button and press your desired key combination (Esc cancels). Click 'Reset defaults' anytime to restore the original shortcuts.
KB.Article.Tray.Title: Playing in the Background (System Tray)
KB.Article.Tray.Summary: Keep the radio playing lightly in the background and show or hide Dial with one click near the clock.
KB.Article.Tray.Body:
Want to keep listening without Dial taking up space on your taskbar or screen?

• Show or hide with one click: Left-click the Dial icon near the Windows clock to bring Dial straight to the front above other windows. Click it once more to minimize Dial back to the system tray.
• Light background memory usage: Whenever Dial is hidden in the system tray, its window interface is cleared from memory while the radio keeps playing smoothly. When you open Dial again, the window loads right back in.
• Minimize, close & startup behavior: In Settings → System Tray & Background, choose whether minimizing or closing the window hides Dial to the system tray, or launch Dial minimized directly in the background.
• Quick menu near the clock: Right-click the Dial icon near the clock to switch stations, pause or mute playback, or cancel an active sleep timer.
KB.Article.Storage.Title: Appearance, Language, Updates & Saved Data
KB.Article.Storage.Summary: Choose light or dark mode, your own accent color, English or Dutch, and find where your data lives.
KB.Article.Storage.Body:
• Colors & theme: In Settings → Appearance, pick Light mode, Dark mode, or follow Windows automatically. You can match your Windows accent color or choose your own using the color swatches and picker (+).
• Language: In Settings → Language & Region, switch live between English and Dutch without restarting.
• Titlebar & what's new: At startup, the titlebar shows a rotating catchphrase next to Dial and displays the active station and song while listening. See a colored dot on the question mark (?) or on 'Changelog'? That means Dial was updated—click it to read what's new. The Feedback button next to it is currently disabled while GitHub issue integration is being built.
• Data, logs & automatic updates: All your favorite stations, preferences, and listening history are saved safely on your computer. In Settings → Storage & Updates, open your data folder or diagnostic logs with one click, choose how often Dial checks GitHub Releases (on startup, daily, weekly, or manually), and install SHA256-verified updates with a What's New summary after restart.
Changelog.v013Alpha.AddedTrayClickToggle: System tray icon now acts as a direct toggle: click once to bring Dial straight to the front above other windows, and click again to minimize it back to the tray while clearing the window from memory so playback stays light in the background.
Changelog.v013Alpha.AddedMiniPlayerOnAir: Added the studio-style red ON AIR badge with a subtle random glowing pulse (plus buffering/stopped/error status pills) beside the station name in the mini-player, matching the main player.
Changelog.v013Alpha.ChangedShareableZipA: Improved sharing to other PCs: releases now ship as a compact .zip package with clear EN/NL startup instructions and checksum verification, alongside complete app info and reduced binary packing to help prevent false antivirus alerts.
Changelog.v013Alpha.FixedTrayRestoreFlas: Fixed the brief white flash when reopening Dial from the system tray so the window appears only once fully rendered, and made minimized startup in the background even lighter by creating tabs only when first opened.
Changelog.v012Alpha.AddedGitHubAutoUpdat: Added an automatic GitHub Releases updater with configurable check frequency (on startup, once a day, once a week, or manual only) and optional pre-release channel support.
Changelog.v012Alpha.AddedUpdateAndWhatsN: Added an interactive SHA256-verified self-install update dialog with download progress and a post-restart What's New modal showing only the latest changelog.
Changelog.v012Alpha.ChangedReleaseManife: Updated build-release.ps1 to emit GitHub Release asset URLs in releases.json and added an automated GitHub Actions release workflow.
Changelog.v011Alpha.AddedTitleBarCatchph: Added live display of the active station and current track beside the version badge in the titlebar.
Changelog.v011Alpha.AddedOnAirBadge: Added a studio-style red ON AIR badge with subtle red glow on the player card and active favorite station row.
Changelog.v011Alpha.AddedTrackLookup: Added quick track lookup from the player and mini-player, configurable in Settings → Radio (toggleable with support for Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer, and Tidal).
Changelog.v011Alpha.AddedDiscoverMinBitr: Added minimum audio quality (bitrate) filtering in Discover (all qualities or 64+ to 320 kbps) with persisted preference and server/client enforcement.
Changelog.v011Alpha.ChangedPerformanceAn: General & performance improvements: snappy volume slider (1% steps, debounced save), instant tab switching, cached theme brushes, decoupled buffer telemetry, idle-pausing VU meter, thread-safe tray menu snapshots, and hardened memory, timeout, URL, and import guards for multi-hour playback.
Changelog.v011Alpha.ChangedFeedbackWip: Marked the titlebar feedback button as greyed-out work-in-progress with a hover notice for upcoming GitHub issue integration.
Changelog.v011Alpha.FixedGeneralUi: General UI fixes: resolved an unintended 'F1' hover tooltip on buttons, locked the sticky edit toolbar to the Windows Compositor to eliminate scroll jitter, added an unread release indicator to the Changelog button, and resolved remaining hardcoded labels and locale mismatches across Sleep Timer, Discover, Knowledge Base, and Settings.
Changelog.v010Alpha.Milestone: First official Alpha release (v0.1.0-alpha): consolidates all prior pre-alpha testing iterations into a cohesive baseline build.
Changelog.v032.UpdatedKnowledgeBase: Updated the built-in Knowledge Base with full coverage of recent features: Edit mode & Radi-oh! import, stream read-ahead buffering (2s–30s), mini-player VU meter & listening stats, customizable global hotkeys, and tray/storage.
Changelog.v031.CustomizableHotkeys: Global hotkeys can now be customized and personalized in Settings → Radio (any Ctrl/Alt/Shift combination with A–Z, 0–9 or Space, live key capture, conflict detection, and reset to defaults).
Changelog.v030.RefactorZeroHardcoding: Refactored codebase for modularity and efficiency: dynamic User-Agent & app identity via AppVersion, shared pooled streaming HttpClient, centralized RadioOptions, idle-safe listening stats timer, and COM teardown on exit.
Changelog.v030.SettingsAlignmentAndColor: Fixed Settings card wrapping and control alignment (uniform 220px dropdowns, flush-right switches) and made the accent color picker clearly visible in a dimmed greyed-out state when following Windows system accent colors.
Changelog.v030.DocumentationReadme: Added a comprehensive README.md covering features, modular architecture, shortcuts, and build instructions.
Changelog.v029.FrameAccuratePlayoutEngin: Upgraded stream playout to a frame-accurate MediaStreamSource queue enforcing exact pre-buffer durations (2s–30s), live buffer telemetry, and stutter-free rebuffer recovery.
Changelog.v028.BufferedStreamEngine: Added a local read-ahead stream buffer proxy with single-connection ICY metadata demuxing, seamless auto-reconnect, and user-configurable buffer duration (2s–30s) in Settings.
Changelog.v027.TrueStickyEditToolbar: Player card now scrolls naturally out of view while keeping only the edit toolbar sticky at the top for long lists.
Changelog.v026.StickyEditToolbar: Made the edit toolbar and player header sticky while scrolling long favorites lists.
Changelog.v025.MovedEditButton: Moved the edit button and edit toolbar directly to the Favorites header for clearer separation from playback tools.
Changelog.v024.AddedBulkSelectionAndDrag: Added item checkboxes, Shift+click range selection, bulk delete, and multi-select drag-and-drop reordering in Edit mode.
Changelog.v023.AddedRadiOhImportAndSmoot: Added Radi-oh! JSON backup import (customName & sorting preserved) with confirmation prompt to append favorites, plus 60fps VU meter smoothing.
Changelog.v022.AddedMiniVuAndControls: Upgraded the mini-player with a full-width transport and volume bar plus a live stereo L/R VU meter.
Changelog.v021.FixedMiniPlayer: Locked the mini-player to a fixed client size (408×186) so the bottom edge is never clipped.
Changelog.v020.RebrandDial: Rebranded to Dial with customizable Radi-oh!-inspired favorites (list/grid toggle, position numbers, alignment, font scale) and inline edit mode.
Changelog.v020.AddedDiscover: Added Discover tab powered by Radio Browser API with A–Z country filter, genre/name search, and live stream preview.
Changelog.v020.AddedTimerStats: Added 6-hour sleep timer, live session counter, persistent per-station listening stats, and .chassispack / DIAL-v1 favorites sharing.
Changelog.v020.AddedMiniHotkeys: Added compact Mini-Player mode (Ctrl+M, Always on Top) and optional global hotkeys.
Changelog.v010.AddedRadio: Added all four KINK live radio stations: KINK, KINK Distortion, KINK 80's, and KINK 90's (192 kbps MP3 with AAC fallback).
Changelog.v010.AddedTray: Added system tray lifecycle with right-click controls and live ICY/SMTC metadata.
